newsitem.title: DENMARK: Denmark's Satair sets share price at 170 crowns.
newsitem.headline: Denmark's Satair sets share price at 170 crowns.

text.p: Danish aviation spares distributor Satair said on Friday that it had set the price per share of its initial offering at 170 crowns after a tender which was heavily oversubscribed.
"The sale of 622,200 shares in Satair was received with great interest and more than 10,500 orders were received," the company said in a statement.
"After consultation with lead manager Aros Securities it was decided to set the price at 170 crowns, at which level the offer was oversubscribed about 16 times," it said.
The nominal 20-crown shares were to have been offered by tender until Friday but were sold out on May 28, the first day of sale.
The shares will begin trading on the Copenhagen Stock Exchange next Tuesday. --Steve Weizman, Copenhagen newsroom +45 33969650
